name: b33_route_v4
what: Waypoints for b33_drive.ps1 (W2DEV) v3.1c, PROPOSED from the DEV rehearsal surveys 1, 2 and 3 (NOT-PREREG) and the DEV kerb survey v2. DIAGNOSTIC tool input, not evidence; path design for the drive, not a measurement threshold; the official route is fixed only by the B-9 survey addendum on the candidate. A waypoint is [x, y] or [x, y, expected soles z] (sender log frame, measured where given).

provenance.calibration_v3: rehearsals 1 / 2 calibrated 6.044 / 5.468 counts/deg (one pass each, 10 % apart); v3.1b drive: 2 passes (+/-40), the mean, refuse if > 8 % apart; the post-turn heading is read over the last 700 ms of a 1.4 s walk (was 400 of 900).
provenance.v4_basis: Rehearsal 3 (DIAGNOSTIC_b33_survey_20261020T232701Z, route v3, drive v3.1b): the approach on the path centre line, the precise corner and the mount WORKED (ON_KERB at (161.5,4449.8,113.1)), but that is the ruled box's south edge (y 4450..4505), and the walk-off went -16 deg: (196.2,4439.7) 108.6 -> FALL (230.5,4429.8) 77.9 -> (255.3,4422.6) 65.5 -> first landing (292.6,4411.8) z 27.5 (a step) = 85.6 uu by the pinned reader (< 100), then (307.4,4402.0) z 5.0. The DEV kerb survey walked straight +x from y 4450 / 4480 / 4505: landings (307.5,4450) -11.8 (drop 124.9), (307.4,4480) 1.5 (111.5), (307.4,4506) 1.7 (111.0). v4 mounts to the middle of the ruled range (mount.to y 4476) and the v3.1c drive probes the walk-off heading to within 5 deg of +x: a straight walk-off from y ~4476 lands on the lawn (1.5) or the slab (-11.8), >= 111 uu below the kerb top.
